title: ATFD Benchmark Submission
description: Schema for ATFD (Agent Trajectory Failure Detection) benchmark result submissions.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool or system being evaluated.

config_effort.description: Effort required to configure the tool before evaluation.

num_rules.description: Number of rules, heuristics, or configuration entries provided to the system (0 = zero-shot).

notes.description: Free-text description of configuration steps, prompts, or setup effort.

results.description: Evaluation results keyed by domain. Must include 'combined' (aggregate). Additional keys are domain names (e.g. 'tau-bench', 'swe-bench', 'synthetic').

combined.description: Aggregate result across all evaluated domains.

methodology.description: Description of how the system was run: judge type, model, prompting strategy, any human-in-the-loop steps, etc.

usd_per_trajectory.description: Mean cost in USD per evaluated trajectory.

latency_seconds_per_trajectory.description: Mean wall-clock latency in seconds per trajectory.

total_api_calls.description: Total API calls made across all trajectories.

notes.description: Any additional cost or pricing notes.

reproduction_url.description: URL to code, config, or instructions needed to reproduce these results.

domain_result.description: Evaluation metrics for a single domain or the combined aggregate.

detection_rate.description: Failure detection rate (recall): fraction of true failures detected. Range [0, 1].

false_positive_rate.description: False positive rate: fraction of non-failures flagged as failures. Range [0, 1].

quality_detection_rate.description: Detection rate weighted by finding quality / severity alignment. Range [0, 1].

f1.description: F1 score balancing detection_rate and (1 - false_positive_rate). Range [0, 1].

category_alignment.description: Fraction of detected failures whose failure category matches ground truth. Range [0, 1].
